basis: TTM GAAP operating values from StockAnalysis standardized data and cross-checked to Broadcom FY2025 plus H1 FY2026 less H1 FY2025 where practical; market cap EV and multiples from StockAnalysis; NTM revenue mechanically derived from market cap divided by forward P/S and is not consensus; normalized net income derived from official Broadcom non-GAAP reconciliations using FY2025 plus H1 FY2026 less H1 FY2025; mature multiples and five-year horizon are analyst test assumptions
source: Broadcom FY2025 and Q2 FY2026 earnings releases / filings; StockAnalysis AVGO statistics page for indicative market data
earnings_basis_notes: Normalized net income is a management-adjusted TTM bridge from official reconciliations. It excludes acquisition-related intangible amortization, stock-based compensation, restructuring and other charges, acquisition-related/integration costs, debt-extinguishment losses and tax adjustments. These exclusions are not necessarily non-recurring; reported GAAP net income remains separately displayed.
